t: This is the Zoological Society of London, the charity behind London Zoo. It was founded in 1826, and it has run the zoo since 1828. Its purpose is the worldwide conservation of animals and their habitats. Thomas Stamford Raffles is named as its founder. He was a British colonial official who governed the Dutch East Indies and later served at Bencoolen, and he wrote The History of Java. The Rafflesia flowers are named after him. The society also runs Whipsnade Zoo, which it has done since 1931.
